description: PoLaRIS MVP interactive demonstration circuits. Each JSON contains both 'instances' (for load_netlist compatibility) and 'devices' (explicit port/dimension metadata for the pipeline).

circuits.name: demo_mzi
circuits.description: Mach-Zehnder Interferometer: 2 Y-branch (splitter+combiner), 2 waveguide arms, 2 grating couplers

circuits.name: demo_ring
circuits.description: Ring Resonator (add-drop): 1 ring, 2 grating couplers, 1 waveguide bus on through port

circuits.name: demo_mzi_switch
circuits.description: MZI with thermal phase shifter: 2 Y-branch, 1 thermo-optic phase shifter, 1 reference waveguide, 2 grating couplers

circuits.name: demo_crosbar
circuits.description: 2x2 optical crossbar: 4 Y-branch (2 splitters + 2 combiners), 4 waveguide routes, 4 grating couplers

circuits.name: demo_complex
circuits.description: Complex photonic circuit: 3 GC, MMI splitter, ring resonator, directional coupler tap, phase shifter, MMI 2x2 combiner, crossing, waveguides, photodetector
